name: door-patch
description: Do all three of a DoorDesc's scripts resolve through door:<map>:<index>:<script>?

_comment: A door:he1_01:9:init patch was here as an out-of-range control. he1_01 has
exactly ONE door (D137), so it addressed nothing and reported NO_SCRIPT --
indistinguishable from a control that simply had not fired. The build now
refuses such a selector against the door catalog (D141).
